note: Harry Judah Weinberg, from a London Gazette notice of 7 September 1929 found by A. Hagues among Douglas McCraith's Gazette entries. Not on any census return in the record. Linked to 4 North Road (#412), created from the same notice.
source: The London Gazette, Trustee Act 1925 notice, 7 September 1929

people.bio:
Merchant, late of 4 North Road, The Park, who died on 1 July 1923. His will was proved in the Nottingham District Registry on 18 September 1923 by his executors John Leo Lewenz, Douglas McCraith and Thomas Galland Mellors. In September 1929 their solicitors, Maples and McCraith of 22 Low Pavement, gave notice to anyone with claims on his estate to come forward by 14 November 1929 before it was distributed.

The Weinberg name was already in The Park: Mehir Weinberg, a shipping merchant and lace manufacturer, lived at Hardwicke House, Cavendish Crescent North, until his death in 1911, and Heattie, Edward and Helene Weinberg were at 1 Holles Crescent that year. How Harry Judah was related to them is not yet known.

occupations.notes: So described in the Gazette notice of his estate, 1929.
